description: The product launch checklist: what a product's website needs before launch day (HTTPS, security headers, email DNS, working links, icons; titles, structured data, a sitemap, AI crawler access; a share image and keywords) and the launch-day and after-launch steps, in order, each with the free MakerRadar tool that checks it. Static; the same for everyone.
